fieldValues.title: containerId filter uses effective container membership
fieldValues.normative_statement: A `containerId` filter predicate MUST match an instance exactly when its id is an entry `instanceId` of the named Container or, under RFC-034 [R8]'s scoping vocabulary, of a container in its `effective(C)` closure ([R18]). Entries are read flat and `depth` is ignored ([R3]); `rootInstanceIds` is removed ([R4]) and the closure itself is unchanged.
